placements.title: Verifying instrument calibration against baseline reference standards ensures measurement fidelity across observing bands
placements.frame: How are observatory instruments verified against historical baseline reference standards to maintain calibration integrity across observing bands?
placements.why: The segments assert and document the calibration and empirical verification of the Kestrelwood spectrograph against reference plates across the full observing band, establishing a durable theme of baseline instrument verification.
